title: Platform overview
body: Skye Business Command Center is a branded operations portal using FreeScout, EspoCRM, InvoiceShelf, Formbricks, and the Skye Hub. It sells deployment, configuration, workflow design, hosting, training, backups, and monthly support.

title: Production gates
body: Not production-complete until VPS, DNS, HTTPS, SMTP, secrets, app installers, admin accounts, mailbox routing, backups, restore proof, and live smoke/acceptance are complete.

title: Safe sales disclosure
body: Some components are open-source. Skyes Over London provides deployment, configuration, hosting, training, workflow setup, and support. Do not claim legal, tax, banking, accounting, payment-processing, HIPAA, SOC2, or compliance certification without separate proof.

title: Operator costs
body: Dedicated small client infrastructure usually runs $25-$75/month. Starter customer pricing can be $497-$1,497 setup plus $99-$299/month; Ops Pro can be $1,997 setup plus $399/month.

title: Local brain architecture
body: brain.html and assets/brain.js provide browser-side retrieval. apps/brain-service optionally calls OpenAI through OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL, or Ollama through OLLAMA_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_MODEL. The default mode remains useful without external AI.

title: Deployment path
body: Copy .env.example to .env, generate secrets, edit domains and SMTP, run preflight, docker compose up -d --build, complete first-run installers, then run smoke and acceptance scripts.
